title: Job: The Cricket Scoreboard
story: Job brief from the local cricket club: show runs, overs and strike rate on the board. Overs are written like 7.3, which means 7 overs and 3 balls.
goal: Write scoreboard(runs, balls) returning text like "45 runs in 7.3 overs, SR 128.57". Strike rate is runs per 100 balls with 2 decimals, and 0.00 when no balls were faced.
hints: Overs are balls divided by 6; the balls left over are balls % 6.
Guard the division: if balls is 0, the strike rate is 0. Format with :.2f.
socratic: How many full overs are 35 balls?
What goes wrong if balls is 0?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Job: The Cricket Scoreboard”?
